blurb: Domaine Willamette produces world-class méthode traditionnelle sparkling wines using biodynamic farming at their estate vineyard in the Dundee Hills. Guests can visit for wine and food pairings, educational tours, and enjoy outdoor gardens and views. The winery also offers private events and an overnight stay at the Founders' Dwelling reflecting their sustainability and hospitality values.
